items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Well I knew Tio, a saxophone player

ctx.x: Yeah. We're going to have to find some of the different fellows that used to work with. With the Maple Leafs. Oh yeah. Yeah. Did you know any of the men in the band?

Well I knew Tio, a saxophone player, but I understand he passed. And there's a little banjo player by the name of Charlie. A little Mexico fellow. I don't know what happened to him. I know him. I think Charlie Boccage. Yeah.
His brothers are calling that trumpet player. Uh huh.
